_comment: Roster is config, not code. check.py auto-discovers Type=simple/exec/notify systemd --user units whose resolved code target lives under project_roots or local_bin_roots (oneshots are always skipped -- they re-exec fresh every run by definition). include_units/exclude_units are overrides on top of that auto-discovery, keyed by unit name. appimage_matchers cover long-running unmanaged processes that never went through systemd (the orca AppImage fuse-mount-pins-old-build case).
